title: Tensor evaluation data into ordinary fixed coefficient modules
statement: Let $W$ be a scheme and $B:\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{CommRing}$ a strict coefficient tower. Use the actual strict-system module category, its ordinary unbounded derived category, the constant-ring realization and the exact level evaluation $e_n$ [def-pur-etale-system-projection-data], and the recorded closed derived tensor calculus $\mathcal A$ [def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus]. Define tensor-evaluation data to consist of ordinary isomorphisms $e_nM\otimes_{B_n}e_nN\cong e_n(M\otimes_{B_\bullet}N)$, sending every local pure tensor to the same pure tensor on the vertical slice; a natural derived tensor isomorphism $e_n( M\otimes^LN)\cong e_nM\otimes^Le_nN$; and a cochain map from the signed total tensor of the two evaluated complexes to evaluation of the signed total tensor, whose restriction to each summand is the ordinary isomorphism followed by evaluation of the actual summand inclusion. The tensors and pure sections are the existing ones [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]; the finite tensor is that on fixed $B_n$-module sheaves. Also name the termwise evaluation and its canonical localization factorization. This data definition does not yet impose the derived representative square.
